title: Manager, Zero Emission Freight
description:
Position Description:

The postholder will be a key member of the Zero Emission Vehicles team at C40 and will support the Latin American Regional team on the Laneshift Initiative implementation in Brazil. The postholder will work with the Director of Implementation, among other team members from the Zero Emission Vehicles Programmes, to support Laneshift project delivery by:

  • Managing the day-to-day execution of the project's workplan across policy, competitive finance, and charging infrastructure workstreams in Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo the e-Dutra green corridor;
  • Coordinating with partner organizations (Smart Freight Centre, Calstart, WRI, ICCT, WBCSD) and ensuring effective collaboration;
  • Managing consultancies and technical service providers, including defining scopes of work and monitoring deliverables;
  • Monitoring project KPIs and preparing comprehensive reports and presentations for internal teams, the project founder, and external stakeholders;
  • Leading business engagement efforts and facilitating collaboration between public and private stakeholders, including fleet operators, commercial vehicle manufacturers, charging point operators, financial institutions, and government entities;
  • Ensuring strategic alignment with the founder's expectations and C40's global and regional directives.

Responsibilities:

  • Project Management and Implementation: Manage the day-to-day execution of the Laneshift Initiative workplan in Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, and the e-Dutra green corridor, ensuring deliverables are met on time and within budget, in coordination with the Head of Laneshift Brazil and C40 colleagues. Coordinate with partner organizations (Smart Freight Centre, Calstart, WRI, ICCT, WBCSD) to ensure aligned implementation and effective collaboration.
  • Consultancy and Service Provider Management: Manage consultancies and technical service providers, including defining scopes of work, monitoring deliverables, and ensuring quality outputs. Develop and maintain project timelines, risk registers, and budget tracking systems.
  • Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting: Monitor and track project KPIs, preparing regular progress reports and presentations for internal teams, the project founder, and external stakeholders. Develop and maintain comprehensive reporting systems, including organization of data sources and analysis for donor reporting and internal evaluation. Support the development of monitoring and evaluation frameworks to track progress toward the initiative's objectives and document outcomes.
  • Communications and Materials Development: Prepare briefing materials and communication materials for various audiences, including mayors, city officials, and business leaders, and collaborate with C40's communications team to showcase project achievements and impact.
  • Business Engagement & Public-Private Coordination: Support business engagement efforts with fleet operators, logistics companies, vehicle manufacturers, charging infrastructure providers, and other private sector stakeholders. Facilitate public-private partnerships and dialogues to advance zero emission freight adoption.
  • Government Coordination: Coordinate with local governments in Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo to ensure alignment between project activities and city priorities. Support the development and execution of stakeholder engagement strategies, including workshops, roundtables, and technical working groups.
  • Stakeholder Relationship Management: Identify and cultivate relationships with new potential partners and stakeholders to expand the initiative's impact. Serve as the primary point of contact for project coordination between cities, partners, and C40 global and regional teams.
  • Strategic Alignment and Coordination: Ensure consistent communication and alignment with the project founder regarding priorities, progress, and strategic direction. Ensure strategic alignment between local implementation, regional priorities, and global C40 directives. Participate in relevant C40 global and regional meetings, contributing insights from the Brazil implementation.
  • Scaling and Replication: Support the identification of opportunities for scaling and replicating successful approaches in other Latin American cities.
  • Additional Responsibilities: Undertake additional duties as required to support the team and organisation, demonstrating flexibility and proactive problem-solving.

Person Specification:

The ideal candidate is a highly organised, proactive, and adaptable professional with strong project management, business engagement, and stakeholder coordination skills. They have demonstrated experience managing complex multi-stakeholder projects in urban mobility and sustainable transportation in Brazil and/or Latin America.

Education, Experience and Technical Knowledge:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Public Policy or related field is highly desired.
  • Extensive professional experience in project management and urban mobility, sustainable transportation, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated track record of successfully managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, partners, and deliverables.
  • Experience managing consultancies and technical service providers, including scope definition, deliverable oversight, and quality assurance.
  • Strong knowledge of urban mobility and zero emission vehicle sectors in Brazil and Latin America.
  • Familiarity with freight transportation, logistics operations, and the commercial vehicle ecosystem.
  • Understanding of sustainable transportation policy frameworks, financing mechanisms, and charging infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience with project management methodologies, KPI tracking, and reporting systems.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to organize and synthesize complex data for various audiences.

Interpersonal and Communication Skills:

  • Exceptional interpersonal and relationship management skills in intercultural and multidisciplinary settings.
  • Proven experience in business engagement and public-private partnership facilitation.
  • Ability to effectively engage with diverse stakeholders including government officials, private sector executives, fleet operators, vehicle manufacturers, financial institutions, and civil society organizations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English, with the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing materials for mayors, city officials, business leaders, and donors.
  • Experience in organizing and facilitating multi-stakeholder workshops, roundtables, and technical working groups.

Organisational and Project Management Skills:

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritise tasks effectively, ensuring deadlines are met and deliverables are of high quality.
  • Experience with budget management, timeline development, and risk management.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, coordinating across disciplines and integrating diverse perspectives.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to respond to changing priorities.
  • Comfortable working in virtual/remote international environments, demonstrating accountability while supporting colleagues across multiple locations, cultures, languages and time zones.
  • Proficient in using digital collaboration tools to coordinate work and maintain clear communication.

Desirable:

  • Experience working with or in municipal administrations or understanding of urban governance.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex multi-stakeholder and multi-disciplinary processes.
  • Spanish proficiency for effective integration with the regional team.

Other Requirements:

Applicants must already have the right to work in the location they are applying for. Moderate travel will be required as part of the role.

We seek to recruit individuals who not only have the appropriate skills and experience for the role, but are committed to carrying out their roles in line with our organisational values.

title: Head of Event Services
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").

The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:
1. Drive FIFA's leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.
2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.

3.Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
4. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence and Project Delivery:

  • Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
  • Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.

Collaboration and Team Integration:

  • Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
  • Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
  • Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC's overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.

Stakeholder Engagement and Networking:

  • Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.
  • Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration

YOUR PROFILE

  • Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity
  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
  • Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. A
SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina
é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,

title: cozinheiro - hospital municipal pedro ii
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Preparar os alimentos que serão servidos para os pacientes, atuando no pré-preparo, o preparo e a finalização de alimentos, observando métodos de cocção e padrão de qualidade dos alimentos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Fundamental Completo;

Experiência no mínimo de 6 meses no cargo de Cozinheiro.

Informações adicionais

Local: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro;

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 36 horas de descanso.

Horário: 07:00 - 19:00.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

  • HABILIDADES/COMPETÊNCIAS: Atenção, Concentração, Comunicação, Detalhismo, Imparcialidade, Atitude, Proatividade, Raciocínio Lógico, Perfil Analítico, Foco em Resultados.

SUMÁRIO DO CARGO:

Realizar análises de qualidade garantindo o cumprimento dos procedimentos e normas, registrar não-conformidades, apoiar nas análises de reclamações de clientes, disseminar as normas com o intuito da padronização das análises laboratoriais e das liberações dos produtos, apoiar em auditorias internas e externas, atuar na atualização de documentos técnicos e na implantação de melhorias nos processos do laboratório. Apoiar em controle de custos corporativos operacionais e demais atividades da área.

O Grupo BAUMINAS é composto por 4 empresas que atuam de maneira integrada na indústria de Saneamento Ambiental. São elas: BAUMINAS Águas, BAUMINAS Mineração, BAUMINAS Log e BAUMINAS Hidroazul.

O DNA do Grupo BAUMINAS equilibra valores tradicionais e atitudes de constante inovação. Assim foi desde a criação da primeira empresa do Grupo, em 1961, até a expansão nacional possibilitada por suas 14 unidades fabris, 3 operações de mineração e 2 escritórios administrativos.

Hoje, as empresas que compõem o Grupo atuam em benefício do bem-estar da população brasileira, contribuindo para a oferta de água tratada.

Em 2021 celebramos 60 anos de atuação em setores absolutamente essenciais, e seguimos comprometidos em transformar positivamente nossa sociedade. Somos múltiplos, sinérgicos, empreendedores. E determinados a evoluir, sempre.

title: Especialista Comercial
description:
A Eneva em Rio de Janeiro I RJ quer você no time #VemSerEneva

Se você quer atuar como Especialista Comercial temos um novo desafio para você

Principais responsabilidades:

Garantir o suprimento competitivo e eficiente de GNL, carvão térmico e outros combustíveis estratégicos para a companhia, realizando compras no mercado spot e contratações de curto, médio e longo prazo desses combustíveis, bem como de soluções logísticas para garantir maior flexibilidade na gestão dos estoques e otimização dos planos comerciais.

  • Realizar análises de mercado e estudos de categoria e estudar continuamente os mercados globais e regionais de GNL, gás natural e carvão térmico, identificando tendências, oportunidades e riscos.Avaliar movimentos de preço, oferta e demanda, contexto geopolítico e impactos logísticos.
  • Realizar compras no mercado spot, bem como executar contratos de curto, médio e longo prazo, com fornecedores internacionais de combustíveis;
  • Realizar contratações no mercado de navegação, tais como o aluguel de navios metaneiros por período, bem como de EBNs para atendimento ao mercado nacional;
  • Gestão de fornecedores e clientes internos e manter relacionamento próximo com fornecedores, traders e stakeholders internacionais, bem como com os clientes internos.
  • Gestão de contratos e operações e apoiar os analistas no acompanhamento e execução de contratos de combustíveis, monitorando prazos, volumes e condições contratuais.
  • Apoiar na programação logística de cargas e no planejamento de recebimento junto a áreas operacionais.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos e serviços da área de Originação, para maior otimização dos ativos da companhia.
  • Interface interna e suporte estratégico
  • Articular com áreas internas (Jurídico, Tributário, Compliance, Operações, Comercial, Comércio Exterior) para viabilizar as operações de trading.
  • Preparar análises, relatórios e apresentações gerenciais para suportar a tomada de decisão e os comitês internos.
  • Inovação e melhoria contínua;
  • Acompanhar os KPIs das áreas sob sua responsabilidade, buscando constantemente oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e ferramentas de trading e originação.

Para se candidatar, você precisa de:

  • Experiência prévia em áreas como: comercial, originação, suprimentos, trading, logística internacional, planejamento energético ou financeiro, especialmente em setores como energia, óleo & gás, mineração, shipping ou commodities em geral.

  • Conhecimento prévio sobre os mercados de GNL, gás natural, carvão térmico ou outros combustíveis.- Conhecimento do mercado internacional de navegação, especialmente relacionado a navios do tipo metaneiro (LNGcs) e de carga seca a granel.

  • Vivência em negociação com contrapartes internacionais e/ou fornecedores globais.

  • Capacidade para executar contratos comerciais complexos com contrapartes no mercado internacional.

  • Execução de análises de risco e dinâmica de mercado.

  • Experiência em trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplas áreas envolvidas (Jurídico, Tributário, Compliance, Operações).

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ

Saiba mais sobre nós visitando o site:

A Eneva é uma empresa séria e comprometida com a transparência em seus processos seletivos e não solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento durante o processo de seleção.

title: Pessoa Consultora de Vendas
description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô , TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Varejo no Grupo Boticário:

Essa é uma oportunidade para fazer parte da Melhor Empresa para se trabalhar no Varejo, segundo o ranking do Glassdoor 2025 Acreditamos que a beleza vai além dos produtos e se manifesta na conexão das nossas histórias e na criação de experiências inesquecíveis, afinal somos a empresa mais presenteável do Brasil e garantimos o brilho no olho dos nossos clientes. Este é o varejo próprio do Grupo Boticário: uma potência com mais de 4 mil lojas e uma presença em 99,9% do território brasileiro, onde milhares de pessoas transformam vidas todos os dias por meio da beleza.

Buscamos uma pessoa consultora de vendas, com disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente, que seja apaixonada pelo universo da beleza, cosméticos e autocuidado, assim como nós.

Queremos conhecer você para construir, juntos, o futuro da beleza

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seu desafio na loja:

  • Consultoria de experiência: Responsável pelo encantamento dos nossos clientes, compreendendo suas necessidades (seja um presente especial, um autocuidado ou um lançamento inovador) para oferecer a solução perfeita.
  • Foco em vendas: apresentar produtos de forma envolvente, bater metas e impulsionar os resultados da loja, sempre com excelência no atendimento.
  • Cuidado com a loja: Auxílio na abertura e fechamento da loja, além de cuidar da organização e reposição da loja, garantindo que o ambiente esteja sempre inspirador e acolhedor.
  • Adorar aprender: participar ativamente dos nossos treinamentos de produto, técnicas de venda e desenvolvimento pessoal.

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no bairro Ipanema, de 12h as 20h;
  • Ensino Médio Completo (com comprovante de escolaridade);
  • Conhecimento sólido em produtos de beleza e bem-estar;
  • Habilidade para maquiagem;
  • Habilidade para atendimento;
  • Experiência em vendas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em técnicas de visual merchandising e gestão de estoque;
  • Experiência em abertura / fechamento de caixa.

O cuidado é a nossa essência Por isso, garantimos que você tenha benefícios diferenciados: um portfólio com mais de 20 opções, pensado para zelar pela sua saúde, bem-estar e de toda a sua família.

Resumo da vaga
Atuar como ponto focal de interface com Supply Management e funções de QA/QC, garantindo inspeções integradas, melhoria do desempenho de fornecedores e gestão de TPI's indicados pelo cliente.

Os principais projetos relacionados a esta posição são a fabricação de skids de processo, módulos offshore e vasos de pressão, incluindo o fornecimento de instrumentos, válvulas e materiais de E&I por fornecedores.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar relatórios periódicos para extração de solicitações de trabalho SAP.
  • Revisar especificações, códigos e normas aplicáveis da indústria (NR, ASME, AWS, ISO, API, entre outras) em relação aos requisitos do projeto.
  • Liderar melhorias de processos, incluindo investigação de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter especificações do cliente e requisitos regulatórios brasileiros, bem como a documentação da qualidade.
  • Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos de fornecedores, como ITPs, procedimentos de fabricação e END, relatórios de END, etc.
  • Coordenar com fornecedores as inspeções e a compilação de documentos (MDB).

  • Gerenciar o processo de NCR (Relatório de Não Conformidade) de fornecedores.
  • Comunicar ativamente problemas e gargalos ao time de Gerencia de projetos e Supply Chain.

  • Reportar periodicamente ao RQM o status das atividades de Qualidade, utilização e demais tarefas atribuídas.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Head of Competition Management and Team Services


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil

  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.

  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS' (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing's seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees' operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams' inspection visits in Brazil as required;
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

Onsite

title: auxiliar de cozinha
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Auxiliar nas tarefas de preparo de alimentos, que serão servidos para os pacientes, conforme orientação do cozinheiro, da técnica ou do Nutricionista, efetuando tarefas de apoio.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Fundamental Completo

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Horário: 07:00 - 19:00 / 10:00 - 22:00

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

title: Quality Analyst
description:
About us:

DTX Aerospace
is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.

About the job:

The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.

Audit & Compliance:

  • Conduct scheduled and unscheduled
    internal audits
    in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC).
  • Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting
    external audits
    (regulatory and customer).

Inspection Oversight:

  • Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
  • Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Non-Conformance Management:

  • Identify and document
    non-conformances (NCRs)
    during audits or inspections.
  • Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
  • Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager.

Documentation & Records:

  • Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function.

Training & Communication:

  • Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
  • Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
  • Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.

Work Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.

Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.

Educational:

High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Soft Skills:

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

Effective written and verbal communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.

Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.

Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
The Technical Project Manager will lead complex technical initiatives from planning through execution. This role partners closely with engineering, product, IT, and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, create timelines, manage resources, and ensure high-quality delivery. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift.

Responsibilities

● Manage end-to-end project lifecycle, including planning, requirements gathering, scheduling, coordination, execution, and delivery.

● Work closely with engineering and product teams to translate business goals into clear project plans and technical requirements across a full SDLC environment.

● Coordinate project resources and workflows to keep teams aligned and accountable to agreed timelines.

● Track project progress, highlight risks or blockers early, and work with stakeholders to solve issues.

● Ensure project documentation is clear, current, and accessible to all relevant teams.

● Facilitate effective cross-functional communication and collaboration across engineering, IT, product, and operations.

● Support process improvements across project management, documentation, release workflows, and communication practices.

● Prepare and present project updates, status reports, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of technical project management experience in a software, health tech, SaaS,
    or related environment.
  • Strong understanding of software development processes and project lifecycle
    management.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects at once.
  • Ability to identify dependencies, assess risks, and communicate tradeoffs with clarity.
  • Experience coordinating with engineering and product teams in both agile and hybrid
    settings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (English B2 or better)
  • Comfortable working with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, Asana, or
    similar).
  • Experience working in regulated environments (healthcare, financial services, or
    enterprise SaaS).
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST.
  • Prior exposure to data privacy or information security considerations as part of project
    delivery

Benefits

  • Competitive pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Working for a cutting edge, industry leading client
  • Advancement opportunities
  • Working with leaders and the brightest minds in the game

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil

  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.

  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS' (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing's seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees' operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams' inspection visits in Brazil as required;
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
  • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.


About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Mechanical Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

    • Authority


  • A Mechanical Technician is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives Instrumentation probationer techs.

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Dismantle Repair and Reassemble Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2 Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • 3 Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4 Identified, checked and prepared components.
  • 5 Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Use of Condition Monitoring on Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2 Make adjustments with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3 Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  • 3) Diagnose faults in Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2 Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3 Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on Mechanical equipment.
  • 4 Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5 Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1 Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2 Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
  • 1 Work area within your own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
  • 2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
  • 3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
  • 4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
  • 6) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds Offshore - Routine Servicing of Systems and Equipment Offshore - Rectifying Faults in Systems and Equipment Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Planning Work Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment Offshore - Safety Management

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • FOR GENERAL MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR PSV CALIBRATION MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Proven experience and/or qualified In PRV/PSV calibration or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with PSV calibration (offshore preferred).
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR CRANE AND HYDRAULIC MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Extensive experience in Hydraulic Cranes Maintenance. Offshore environment would be preferable.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of Crane and Lifting International Standards
  • Good knowledge of CMMS systems such as AMOS / IFS and ePTW
  • Strong planning & organizational skills
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo: 

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão: 

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

description:
1.-Finalidade da Posição

Administração da Função:

Controle de Investimentos:

  • Garantir a correta contabilização de imobilizado (ativação, baixa, melhorias, reclassificações).

  • Elaborar relatórios de performance e dashboards executivos (Power BI / Excel avançado).

  • Revisar e validar pedidos de investimento, assegurando documentação adequada.

  • Executar testes de impairment quando requerido.

  • Padronizar processos e aprimorar controles internos vinculados ao ciclo de CAPEX.

  • Preparar apresentações gerenciais de status de portfólio.

Requisitos:



• Formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
• Experiência prévia em Controladoria, Finanças ou área relacionada a gestão de investimentos (CAPEX).

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect. Rio de Janeiro. Posting Date: 01/16/2026. Deadline: 01/29/2026

Role Title: Enterprise Architect

Contract Type: Regular

Reporting To: Deputy CIO

Program/Department/Unit Name: Information Technology

Location: Rio & Mexico City

Team Name: IT Governance

Role Purpose

The Enterprise Architect role is responsible for designing and managing the overall architecture of an organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves aligning IT strategy with business goals, creating architectural frameworks, and ensuring that technology solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient. The Enterprise Architect collaborates with various internal and external stakeholders to identify technology needs and guide the implementation of IT initiatives.

Key responsibilities

As the Enterprise Architect, your key responsibilities are as follows:

  • Establish EA governance, EA frameworks, EA methodology and create EA artifacts, EA standards and best practices.
  • Design and promote architectural standards, guidelines, and best practices across the organization.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform architectural decisions and recommendation
  • Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes to ensure compliance with architectural standards.
  • Provide guidance and support to project teams in implementing architectural solutions.
  • Instruct, manage, and mentor development teams
  • Communicate enterprise architecture with other department managers within the organization, outsourcing providers and report on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee Change Control board, participate in Project Review Board to ensure adherence to architectural standards.     

People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)

No

Key metrics

EA KPIs such as strategic alignment, business process optimization, innovation enablement, efficiency, architecture compliance and risk management

Key internal relationships

CIO, Deputy CIO, Functional leads, Operations leads, GDPR team, Legal, Finance, Global Security, IT Security, Technology Services, System/Application Owners, Program/Opportunity leads.

Key external relationships

IT vendors in various markets, external consulting experts, EA colleagues at non-profit institutions with similar IT landscape, large global software providers, etc. 

The ideal candidate

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field
  • Master's degree in IT management, business management, or enterprise architecture
  • Certifications such TOGAF, CISSP (for cybersecurity focus), and cloud-specific certifications from providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial
  • 10 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a background in software engineering, network security, cloud computing, systems analysis, data management or other related fields.
  • Strong understanding of business needs, technology trends, and architectural frameworks.
  • Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
  • Experience with architecture modelling tools CAD, BIM, and 3D modelling software.
  • Strong understanding of IT enterprise systems and platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday) and architectures
  • Deep knowledge of various technologies, including cloud computing, data management, networking, and security.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to analyse complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Ability to lead and mentor development teams and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience with architectural frameworks and methodologies TOGAF or Zachman, and agile methodologies.
  • Experience with cloud computing, network security, data management, and application integration.
  • High level understanding and interest of geo-political implications of Open Society's work.
  • Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.

Languages

  • An excellent knowledge of English

What we offer  

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:
    • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
    • Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
    • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
    • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

The salary range for this role in the US is $ 145,666 - $ 161,851 (USD). The final offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set and level of experience

Who we are       

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder's values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Additional information

Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

Competitive rates of pay apply.

Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply.   

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A pessoa Product Manager de Inteligência Artificial irá definir e gerenciar a estratégia de produtos de Inteligência Artificial da empresa, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.

Será responsável por identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA, priorizar casos de uso, construir e gerenciar o roadmap de produtos de IA, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos, e garantir a entrega de valor mensurável através de soluções de IA. Irá liderar a descoberta, validação e evolução de produtos de IA, assegurando alinhamento estratégico, viabilidade técnica, adoção pelos usuários e retorno sobre investimento.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir e manter a estratégia de produtos de IA da empresa, construindo e gerenciando roadmap priorizado de iniciativas, alinhado aos objetivos estratégicos do negócio e às capacidades tecnológicas, garantindo visibilidade e comunicação clara para stakeholders;
  • Conduzir pesquisas contínuas com usuários e áreas de negócio para identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA, problemas a serem resolvidos e necessidades não atendidas, validando hipóteses através de discovery techniques e análise de viabilidade;
  • Avaliar e priorizar casos de uso de IA baseado em critérios de valor de negócio, esforço técnico, viabilidade, impacto estratégico e riscos, gerenciando portfólio de iniciativas e garantindo alocação eficiente de recursos;
  • Planejar e conduzir experimentos, MVPs e POCs para validar hipóteses de produto antes de investimentos maiores, utilizando abordagens lean e iterativas, coletando feedback e aprendizados para informar decisões de produto;
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso e KPIs para produtos de IA, medir valor entregue (eficiência, produtividade, receita, satisfação), ROI de iniciativas, e utilizar dados para otimização e tomada de decisão;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com equipes de engenharia, IA e design durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento, participando de cerimônias ágeis, removendo impedimentos, validando entregas e garantindo qualidade e aderência aos requisitos.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Produção, Administração com foco em Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável ter Pós-Graduação, MBA ou especialização em Gestão de Produtos, Product Management, Inteligência Artificial, Transformação Digital, Inovação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de produtos digitais ou de tecnologia;
  • Experiência prática trabalhando com produtos de IA, Machine Learning ou tecnologias emergentes;
  • Experiência comprovada em descoberta e validação de produtos, construção e gestão de roadmaps de produtos, mensuração de valor e métricas de produto;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e práticas de product discovery;
  • Inglês - Avançado/Fluente.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As a Mechanical Engineer, you are responsible for providing technical expertise in mechanical systems across the fleet, ensuring operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and compliance with industry standards. This role involves troubleshooting mechanical issues, supporting audits by regulatory agencies and clients, and providing strategic technical recommendations to enhance operability, increase business revenue, and safeguard equipment performance. The Mechanical Engineer plays a key role in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Technical Risk Assessment (TRA), and management of change (MoC), ensuring adherence to best practices and continuous process improvement. By aligning technical action plans with organizational objectives, the engineer helps drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities

  • You provide mechanical expertise to identify and resolve technical issues across the fleet, developing and implementing action plans to enhance system reliability and operability.
  • You support regulatory agency audits, as well as internal and client audits, ensuring compliance with industry standards and company policies.
  • You offer technical recommendations aimed at improving equipment protection, optimizing control device performance, and highlighting potential technical risks. You contribute to the development of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and participate in Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), proposing actionable plans to mitigate risks and prevent future issues.
  • You play a key role in the company's Strategy and Governance, ensuring alignment with best practices, Class issues, regulatory requirements, and GTS standards.
  • You drive Continuous Improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize mechanical processes and systems, proposing initiatives, and ensuring their implementation aligns with company goals. You provide technical support to unit operations, guiding management decisions with expert insights on mechanical systems.
  • You assist the Supply Chain in evaluating technical proposals for services or materials that deviate from like-for-like standards, ensuring quality and compliance. You serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for evaluating Management of Change (MoC) and QnA in mechanical disciplines, ensuring thorough analysis and proper documentation. You develop and issue Technical Notes and Guidelines, sharing lessons learned and promoting best practices across the fleet to enhance operational performance and compliance with company standards.
  • You define and execute a 3-Year Plan (3YP) related to Mechanical scope, supporting budget exercises and strategic initiatives. You promote interface with suppliers, vendors, and subcontractors, conducting technical interviews and participating in meetings.

Education

  • Mechanical Engineering graduation;
  • CREA active (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Arquitetura
  • (Architecture and Civil Engineering Regional Council)

Experience

  • Experience in O&G industry projects
  • Experience in relevant projects in oil and gas industry acting as engineer or interface coordinator.

Functional Competencies
Mechanical Static Equipment - Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems

Integrity and Reliability - Remote Surveillance and Monitoring

Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring

Learning from events

Reliability, operability and safety

Mechanical Static Equipment - Cranes and winches

Integrity and Reliability - Spares Analysis

Troubleshooting

Mechanical Static Equipment - Pressure Vessel

Analysis

GENERAL INFORMATION
SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
